dedupe_keys.name: multi resolution dataset for photovoltaic panel segmentation from satellite and aerial imagery

description: The Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Provincial Geomatics Center of Jiangsu publish image samples for segmenting photovoltaic panels. The resource separates three resolutions: PV08 uses 0.8 m Gaofen-2 and Beijing-2 imagery, PV03 uses 0.3 m aerial photographs, and PV01 uses 0.1 m UAV orthophotos. Samples distinguish rooftop and ground installations, with further background categories for ground cover and roof materials. Zenodo lists ZIP and split-archive files under CC-BY-4.0, available openly and free of charge. A limitation is that this is a labelled image collection released in 2021, not a dated national generating-capacity inventory; acquisition dates and exact site coverage were not established from the repository metadata. Modellers could use it to train panel detection before estimating rooftop potential or mapping exposed assets for energy-system simulations. Detection results still need area-to-capacity assumptions and local validation. It complements data-global-renewables-watch-solar-wind by providing training imagery, not a ready global asset layer.
